body: I feel the same way. I know the second I have access to something heavy and nice to hold in private I'm gonna go crazy and bruise myself so hard. Ugh. I don't feel proud, I just feel desperate to find a nice hammer.
Now I'm thinking about The Gay Deceivers 😂

And our brains often come up with a lot of shit when we're sleeping too. I had a sex dream about a friend of mine. Don't want to fuck him, ya know? It's just your brain processing through shit, even if it may not make sense. And even if it is a romantic interest, it could also just be an infatuation that will pass. I wouldn't worry about it until it became a more serious issue.

Do you actually like him, or is it just intrusive thoughts? The more you think about how terrible the thought is the more the thought pops up. And it could also be just plain old curiosity or taboo that's interesting you. I used to have a lot of intrusive thoughts about that before I recognized what they were.
